description: Read AIURION's supported 3D model formats, limits, materials, production options, and purchasing flow.
name: printing.capabilities.get

overheadMinutesPerPlate.description: Setup, warmup and cooldown minutes per occupied plate.

sellingCentsPerGram.description: Material selling rate in USD cents per gram.

maxFileSizeMb.description: Maximum decoded model size in megabytes.

maxQuantity.description: Maximum units accepted in one quote.

printPricing.description: Machine-time pricing: the $100 job charge includes the first 60 machine minutes, including setup and cooldown; additional time is $1/minute. Material, rush, fulfillment, and tax are additional. Use returned server totals.

additionalMachineCentsPerMinute.description: Charge in currency cents per minute beyond the included allowance.

includedMachineMinutes.description: Machine minutes included in the job charge, including setup and cooldown.

jobChargeCents.description: Job charge in currency cents, including the initial machine-time allowance.

materialChargeAdded.description: Whether material charges are added to machine-time pricing.

minimumAppliedOncePerBuild.description: Whether the job minimum applies once across the build.

overheadBasis.description: Basis for setup and cooldown allowances: occupied_plate means each occupied plate incurs an allowance.

quantityAlreadyIncludedInSlice.description: Slice totals already include all requested copies; do not multiply again.

samePartMultiMaterial.description: Policy for a single part using multiple materials; human_review_required means manual review is needed.

publicGuestAccess.description: Guest access limits and entry tool.

quotePrice.description: Price charged to generate a quote.
